主要内容: On February 10, 2014, Asta Funding, Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial results for the first quarter of the fiscal year ending September 30, 2014. The press release, which includes financial information, is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to the Current Report on Form 8-K. The information in this report is not deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference into any registration statement or other document pursuant to the Securities Act of 1933. The press release is an important communication regarding the company's financial performance for the quarter.
